reason: The cited evidence confirms that atomic-size mismatch causes lattice distortion (E2) and that Al-containing HEAs undergo ordering and precipitation reactions (E3), but none of the passages provide specific support for the claimed optimal Al tuning of entropy-enthalpy balance, the suppression of ordering by modest Al, or the direct link to the listed property enhancements.
premises: Atomic-size mismatch (primarily from Al) tunes the balance between mixing entropy and ordering enthalpy.
Modest Al promotes lattice distortion that suppresses brittle ordered/precipitate phases while preserving a single-phase structure.
Excessive Al leads to local chemical ordering or precipitate formation that degrades properties.
Lattice distortion increases free energy barriers for ordering or phase separation.
An optimal Al content stabilizes a single-phase structure with a beneficial balance of defect activity and phase stability.
